item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: Make this pic of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.** Your photo is already uploaded, so no upload step is needed.

Your request is clear: an **8-second square video**, the exact script, a friendly female English voice—not a clone—and no captions.

**I can’t give you a verified credit quote with the tools available here.** They don’t expose your balance or an account-specific price estimate, so I won’t run a job without that information and your approval.

There’s also a free-plan limitation: the dedicated **scripted presenter** tool is capped at **5 seconds unless you’ve purchased a credit pack**. The separate talking-photo tool requires an existing audio recording; it cannot turn your text into speech.

### Cheaper options
- **Smaller:** 480p is the free-plan video setting and the lowest available here. Your square photo needs no preparatory edit.
- **Shorter:** A 5-second version may reduce cost, but your full script would sound rushed. Around 8 seconds is more natural.
- **Keep every word:** An audio-enabled image-to-video route could be considered, but I can’t verify its price here or guarantee exact wording and voice characteristics.
- **Most predictable alternative:** Supply a recording made with a generic female text-to-speech voice, then animate the portrait to it—though that animation still needs a verified quote.

**My recommendation:** keep the 8-second timing and avoid any paid generation until its exact credit charge is confirmed. I won’t silently shorten your script or use a different model to get around the limit.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed
